description: Read current task context with provenance and separate readiness signals. Nonempty intent is authoritative for this invocation; empty arguments preserve prior activation. Security constraints still apply. Use get_activation_payload to inspect the activated scope.

compact.description: When true, apply ISC-gated compaction before returning (only fires when ISC decision is SUFFICIENT)

expectedRuntimeVersion.description: Optional expected server runtime version. A mismatch refuses activation instead of silently using a stale runtime.

intent.description: Optional task intent; used to activate task context before returning a bundle

name: get_active_context
